meta.canvas: bData · three registers — new bee / raver / cypherpunk (graded A- 2026-09-19)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: paper in new bee; the black the mandala sings on in raver and cypherpunk. the page ground of every surface.

tokens.name: bg-card
tokens.usage: cards and list groups sitting on `bg`.

tokens.name: bg-well
tokens.usage: the register toggle's track in new bee and raver; table heads and code wells in cypherpunk.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: card edges and hairlines. decoration only — never the only edge of a control; controls are edged in `ink`.

tokens.name: line-soft
tokens.usage: separators between rows inside a card.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: reading text on `bg`, `bg-card`, `bg-well` and every wash; the 1.5px edge of outline buttons; the fill of the active new bee register pill.

tokens.name: ink-mut
tokens.usage: secondary text on `bg` and `bg-card`: descriptions, source counts, the line under a button.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: resting register labels on `bg-well`; second lines of cypherpunk rows on `bg`.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: the quietest text the sheet allows: on `bg` in every register, and on `bg-card` in new bee. on the dark `bg-card` it reads 4.4:1 — the sheet's own value, kept exact — so use `ink-mut` for words there. also the dashed edge of a plain row.

tokens.name: sovereign
tokens.usage: human purple — all souls. the more human a surface, the more of it. links, quiet actions and product names on `bg` and `bg-card`; found ancestors in the raver fan chart.

tokens.name: sovereign-strong
tokens.usage: human purple pressed: link hover, the open generation, initials — on `bg`, `bg-card`, `sovereign-wash` and `sovereign-tint`.

tokens.name: sovereign-soft
tokens.usage: member seats; links and source lines in raver, on `bg` and `bg-card`.

tokens.name: sovereign-wash
tokens.usage: the fill behind human things: initials discs in new bee, pressed consent glyphs in raver. carries `sovereign-strong` or `ink`.

tokens.name: sovereign-tint
tokens.usage: the open row or the aside that talks about family. carries `sovereign-strong` or `ink`.

tokens.name: you
tokens.usage: you — the one acting, distinct from all souls. the order's "action". a fill under `on-primary`, or a word on `bg` and `bg-card` ("signed").

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: the one filled control a view is for. magenta in new bee and raver; cypherpunk hands it to `ai`. once per view.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: the label on a `primary` fill.

tokens.name: register-on
tokens.usage: the fill of the pressed register pill; its label is `bg`.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: link text on `bg` and `bg-card`.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: a link under the pointer, on `bg` and `bg-card`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: the keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 3px clear of the control, on every ground.

tokens.name: guard
tokens.usage: guard lilac — the system declined, and nothing broke: living people held out, a refusal working as built. never red. words, the lock and dashed edges on `guard-wash`, `bg` and `bg-card`.

tokens.name: guard-wash
tokens.usage: the ground of a guard row. cypherpunk keeps the page ground and lets the dashed edge speak.

tokens.name: verified
tokens.usage: settled · confirmed by test · current. always with its word and the check, on `verified-wash`, `bg` and `bg-card`.

tokens.name: verified-wash
tokens.usage: the ground of a verified chip.

tokens.name: biomass
tokens.usage: BeehiveBioMass — life; saturation follows biomass. a datum colour: fills, seals, chart marks; as words on `bg` and `bg-card` only.

tokens.name: ai
tokens.usage: robots and the network — the machine base. the spinner while the network is asked, agent rows, every cypherpunk action. on `bg` and `bg-card`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: informational — kept apart from `ai`. on `bg` and `bg-card`.

tokens.name: b-value
tokens.usage: honey — the colour of b. b amounts only, on `b-chip` only. 1.88:1 on paper, so never text on a light ground, and never repainted: recolouring it is recolouring a currency.

tokens.name: b-chip
tokens.usage: the dark chip a b amount sits on, the same in every register.

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: love given to the living — the garden red, and the heart in the house hand. odd counts only. never a status, never an error, never currency. a fill or a large mark on `bg`.

tokens.name: rose-deep
tokens.usage: `rose` pressed toward the heart of the bloom. a fill beside `rose`, never words.

tokens.name: cat-works
tokens.usage: chart marks, first in order: works. validated on the dark ground only; on paper it is a mark, never words. always with a glyph and a label.

tokens.name: cat-idea
tokens.usage: chart marks, second: idea. never beside `cat-bug` without a gap. dark ground validated; marks only on paper.

tokens.name: cat-bug
tokens.usage: chart marks, third: bug. never beside `cat-works` (the weakest pair for red-green colour blindness). marks only.

tokens.name: cat-gap
tokens.usage: chart marks, fourth: gap. reuse the four in order; never reorder, never add a hue.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.ui: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

groups.name: the house hand
groups.note: burti — the original latvian letterform of the .a/.b names: one round-capped line, circles for bowls, the full latvian court, and the dot is a cell. names, titles and signs; never reading text.

styles.name: house-display
styles.usage: the estate's name and the motto, on covers, posters and doors.

styles.name: house-name
styles.usage: product and people names in the founder's casing, through the wordmark component: capitals heavy, small letters light.

styles.name: house-name-sm
styles.usage: the name above a page title, in the masthead.

styles.name: house-sigil
styles.usage: the signs cut into the font: ☼ saule, ✶ auseklis, ‡ jumis, ✚ māra's cross, ⬡ the cell, ♡ the bond.

groups.name: new bee
groups.note: one question at a time. reading text never under 16px; 14px is for secondary labels only.

styles.name: bee-display-xl
styles.usage: the one word that ends a ceremony.

styles.name: bee-display
styles.usage: the page question or title. one per screen.

styles.name: bee-figure
styles.usage: the price, in the network's own unit.

styles.name: bee-title
styles.usage: the heading of an aside.

styles.name: bee-action
styles.usage: the label on the `primary` button and the line that names a waiting state.

styles.name: bee-body
styles.sample: a library of the people you come from.
styles.usage: reading text. the floor.

styles.name: bee-body-strong
styles.sample: it can't be changed or taken down.
styles.usage: row labels (500 at rest, 600 when it is the point), quiet actions, the consent line.

styles.name: bee-note
styles.sample: it joins a public family library.
styles.usage: the second line of a consent term; the words in a guard row at 600.

styles.name: bee-label
styles.usage: secondary labels: register pills, row values, chips, the line under a button (400).

styles.name: bee-address
styles.usage: addresses and hashes, shown whole, never cut at the point of confirmation.

groups.name: raver
groups.note: everything expressed through art, graphics, animation. lowercase is allowed joy; the numbers never change.

styles.name: raver-display-xl
styles.usage: the poster word.

styles.name: raver-display
styles.usage: the screen title.

styles.name: raver-action
styles.usage: the label on the `primary` pill.

styles.name: raver-glyph
styles.usage: the word under a consent glyph. the glyph never stands without it.

styles.name: raver-body
styles.sample: Albert Perry Rockwood + Julianna Sophia Olsen Rockwood
styles.usage: names and the line that matters.

styles.name: raver-label
styles.usage: register pills, captions, quiet actions (400 for plain captions).

styles.name: raver-small
styles.usage: source lines and legends.

groups.name: cypherpunk
groups.note: everything an engineer wants. the pipeline is the interface; every row is a fact you can check.

styles.name: cypher-title
styles.usage: the resource being read; wraps anywhere, never cut.

styles.name: cypher-action
styles.usage: the label on the `primary` button.

styles.name: cypher-body
styles.sample: single-flight across tabs · timeout 150 s · automation refused
styles.usage: rows, tables and receipts.

styles.name: cypher-small
styles.usage: register pills and second lines.

styles.name: cypher-tag
styles.usage: state tags and table heads.

groups.name: zero-fetch
groups.note: estate surfaces ship system stacks and fetch nothing. a live surface sets the same sizes in `ui` (and `mono`) when the faces above are not on the box.

styles.name: ui-body
styles.sample: your files — who can get them, and what it costs to keep them.
styles.usage: reading text on a live estate surface.

spacing.note: senary rhythm: every step is a multiple of 6.

tokens.name: s1
tokens.usage: the gap between register pills and the padding of their track; icon to label.

tokens.name: s2
tokens.usage: between an icon and its words in a row; between stacked controls.

tokens.name: s3
tokens.usage: the page gutter at 390px; the padding of a card.

tokens.name: s4
tokens.usage: the foot of a screen; between sections.

tokens.name: s5
tokens.usage: between a title block and what follows on a wide page.

tokens.name: s6
tokens.usage: between chapters of a long page.

radius.note: new bee is soft, raver is round, cypherpunk is cut.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: cypherpunk: rows, tables, buttons (its pills inside the toggle drop to 5px, tags to 4px).

tokens.name: radius
tokens.usage: the sheet's base corner: guard rows, small outline buttons, plain rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: the 48px outline button in new bee.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: the `primary` button in new bee.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: cards and list groups in new bee and raver.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: the register toggle, chips, initials discs; every raver button.

control.note: a control you can hit with a thumb. 44px is the floor in every register.

tokens.name: control-min
tokens.usage: the smallest height or width of anything that takes a press: register pills, quiet actions, summaries.

tokens.name: control-row
tokens.usage: a row in a list card.

tokens.name: control-primary
tokens.usage: the `primary` button in new bee (raver's pill is 58px, cypherpunk's bar 52px).

tokens.name: control-person
tokens.usage: a person row: a 40px initials disc with room to breathe.

tokens.name: control-check
tokens.usage: the consent checkbox, inside a 44px label.

shadow.note: glow, never drop-shadow theatrics. new bee uses edges, not shadows.

tokens.name: glow-sovereign
tokens.usage: the halo around the raver fan chart — the family line lit from within.

tokens.name: glow-ok
tokens.usage: a settled thing on the dark ground.

gradient.note: one gradient, and it is a name.

tokens.name: rainbow
tokens.usage: skaists — the mandala read rim to centre. a rule, a seal edge, a poster band; never behind reading text. in a right-to-left page it runs 270deg.

direction.note: right-to-left is a first-class layout. an angle is the one physical thing here, so it is a token and flips once.

tokens.name: flow
tokens.usage: every left-to-right sweep; 270deg under dir=rtl.

tokens.name: hatch
tokens.usage: diagonal texture; 135deg under dir=rtl.
